intervention.trustCrossing.title: HIL · Trust Boundary
intervention.trustCrossing.body:
The agent is about to introduce: {entities}.
This is outside your configured trust boundary (status: {status}).
This is not a safety verdict — it is a decision worth keeping with you. Quick review areas:
  • What data flows to, or is stored by, this service?
  • Who controls the credentials and keys?
  • What permissions and dependencies does it add?
  • Any vendor lock-in, licensing, or migration implications?
Your call: allow, reject, or investigate first.
Trust permanently: hil trust add {first} · Silence this session: /hil mute
intervention.trustCrossingDenied.title: HIL · Trust Boundary (decision pending)
intervention.trustCrossingDenied.body:
This action was paused because it introduces: {entities}.
That is outside the user's configured trust boundary (status: {status}), and the user has not made this decision yet — in the current permission mode there is no way to surface a prompt, so the decision is being returned here.
This is not a safety verdict. Please ask the user whether to introduce {first} before retrying.
If the user approves, they can run: hil trust add {first}   (or for this session only: /hil trust add {first} --scope session)
cli.help:
HIL — Human Agency Guardrail for agentic AI coding tools

Usage: hil <command> [options]

Commands:
  hook                                process one agent hook event (JSON on stdin)
  install [--scope user|project|local]
                                      wire HIL into Claude Code settings
  uninstall [--scope user|project|local]
                                      remove exactly what install wrote
  trust add <name...> [--category <c>] [--status <s>]
                    [--scope global|project|session] [--session-id <id>]
  trust remove <name> [--scope global|project]
  trust list [--scope global|project]
  status [--session-id <id>]          current session: decisions, cooldowns, mute
  review [--session-id <id>]          this session's decision log
  mute [--session-id <id>] [--category <c>]
  resume [--session-id <id>]
  sync                                recompile trust caches from YAML/SQLite

Options:
  --lang en|zh-CN     language for this invocation (default: config / en)
  --version, -v       print version
  --help, -h          this help

Philosophy: awareness, not restriction. The agent stays fully capable; HIL only
returns a decision to you when it crosses your declared boundary.
cli.error: HIL error: {message} (fail-open — your session is unaffected)
cli.install.done: HIL installed. An empty trust boundary is fine: HIL asks once per category, then stays quiet. Add entries anytime with `hil trust add <name>`.
cli.uninstall.clearedStates: Cleared {count} ephemeral session state file(s) — derived data only; your config.yaml / trust-boundary.yaml are untouched.
cli.trust.sessionIdRequired: No active HIL session found — session-scope trust needs a running session (see `hil status`).
cli.trust.listEmpty: Trust boundary is empty ({scope}). Add entries with `hil trust add <name>`.
cli.status.noSession: No HIL session state found. Sessions are ephemeral; state appears while an agent session with HIL hooks is running.
cli.review.empty: No decisions recorded in this session.
cli.mute.done: HIL muted ({scope}). Interventions paused. Resume with `hil resume`.
cli.sync.done: Compiled trust caches: {global} global entries, {project} project entries.
